description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange
reasoning: The gazette content is a Customs notification issued under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It formally sets and publishes new statutory rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges. This is a regulatory matter that establishes a legal framework for financial calculations in trade, falling squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). It does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or fit any other specialized category better.
